name: Ways of Athena
review:
Greek myth on a 3x5 grid that starts with 243 ways and can grow to 43,923. Wilds and matching mystery symbols lead into free spins where the features get stronger as you go.

That huge jump in ways is where the 25,000x cap comes from. High volatility. The published RTP is 94.21%, below average. A big-ceiling game, but expect quiet stretches.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
